active_family: 653 candidate: positive-level preprocessing and/or path distribution objective on shared-source multi-head joint path model
current_bottleneck: 652a validates the shared-source multi-head decoder idea but does not solve IV path-law calibration. IV-only reaches 5/11 and passes conditionality, horizon coverage, daily-change KS, cross-cell correlation, cointegration, and aggregate h1 mean reversion, while joint38 reaches 4/11 and has strong native factor/IV-factor co-movement. If positivity preprocessing is not enough, add a single path distribution objective on the same backbone rather than another model family.
